svg.text: V4 physical CSA | single-clock comparator and replenishment channel
One complete CSA contains amplifier, compensation and feedback MOM. CLK alone drives the phase generator; trim sources emulate backend registers.
Held bit: sample once per cycle
Cf is the physical 18 x 18 MOM inside X_CSA. No external Cf or analog reset.
CIN is the external detector capacitance.
Default-off diagnostic noise stimulus; native noise is separately enabled
CHANNEL SOURCE-POWER DOMAINS | SERIES FEED + DECOUPLING
Diode bias interfaces; external current seeds remain explicit.
PARAMS | select the code block and press q for the complete simulator defaults.
GUI default: measured room / 10 MHz timing mode; 3 pF / 50 fF; 1.8 V; explicit known analog initial state. Load matching codes/bias before changing temperature.
PHYSICAL CLOCK GENERATION | no external periodic EVAL / CAPTURE / PHASE
STATIC CONFIGURATION STIMULUS | 60 physical MOS control inputs
Measured CSA common-well A/P supplement, once in both source and PEX.
V_CSA_INPUT_SENSE includes the internal feedback-MOM current; it is not a gate-only probe.
